infobox.usage: Unlocks a room in the old house at the train depot on Woods.

sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: Old house room key (Depot) is a Key in Escape from Tarkov.

sections.heading: Description
sections.text: A key to one of the rooms in an old house somewhere on the edge of the Priozersk forest. It is said that a person nicknamed Ogryzok used to trade in these parts. He used to sell rare goods including even a steady supply of tank batteries. Yet nothing had long been heard of Ogryzok, and no one knows where he had disappeared to.

sections.heading: Key Location
sections.text:
- In Jackets
- In Drawers
- Pockets and bags of Scavs

sections.heading: Quest Rewards
sections.text: - 1 can be obtained as a quest reward from Swift Retribution

sections.heading: Lock Location
sections.text: Door to a room in the old house at the train depot on Woods. Note: The street in front of the house is partially in the reach of border snipers, therefore it is recommended to stay close to the house while entering and leaving.

sections.heading: Behind the Lock
sections.text:
- 1x Sports bag
- 2x Weapon box (4x4)
- 6-STEN-140-M military battery spawn
- Loose loot (Valuables)
- Loose Military power filter spawns
